locator.title: Топ-6 нестандартных планировок квартир от Level Group
locator.lead: Покажем несколько вариантов в разных районах Москвы
locator.caption: Пример гардеробной на плане квартиры — при желании в ней можно хранить сезонные вещи

nearest_text_after.text: 🔥 В премиальной коллекции квартир от Level вы найдёте просторные квартиры, которые сможете превратить в пространство своей мечты: уютный вариант с несколькими детскими, минималистичный островок спокойствия с отдельной рабочей зоной или центр притяжения семьи, где собираются все близкие. И всё это в любом районе Москвы, даже в центре. Выбирайте, что вам нравится, и не бойтесь экспериментировать: места хватит даже для нестандартных решений.

image_reading: A static top-down apartment floor plan contains exact room outlines, doors, furniture symbols, area numbers, blue exterior-window marks, and a black arrow pointing toward the central room marked “3,9”.
The central “3,9” space is drawn with storage fixtures along its sides and is connected to adjacent circulation areas by fixed walls and door openings.
The image is a diagram whose labels, arrow, topology, dimensions, and symbols carry semantic meaning; no physical subject action or depth-based camera motion is evidenced.
analysis.article_context: The body image is a precise apartment floor plan illustrating the section about a dedicated walk-in wardrobe and convenient storage for seasonal belongings; the editorial focus is the centrally marked wardrobe area within the broader spacious layout.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Direct attention to the dedicated walk-in wardrobe as a practical storage feature within a spacious, adaptable apartment.
structured_intent.initial_state: A complete static apartment plan is shown, with a black arrow pointing toward the central storage room labeled “3,9”.
structured_intent.primary_action: A bounded deterministic 2D push-in emphasizes the arrow endpoint and central wardrobe.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The central “3,9” wardrobe and arrow endpoint occupy a larger portion of the frame while the plan remains legible and unchanged.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: All walls, doors, fixtures, room boundaries, adjacency, and arrow-to-wardrobe alignment remain fixed.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: Preserve every room, furniture symbol, area label, window mark, and the single black arrow exactly once and unchanged.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The image remains an accurate apartment plan whose highlighted central room represents a dedicated wardrobe/storage space.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The arrow and enclosed room marked “3,9” unambiguously establish the editorial target, but the image is a flat technical diagram with no evidenced physical motion or reliable depth. Exact numbers, glyphs, boundaries, doors, and topology are semantically important, so generative I2V is unsafe.

models.scene_plan: Over 5 seconds, apply one smooth, bounded 2D push-in centered on the arrow tip and the room marked “3,9”. Begin immediately at a steady pace, ease gently near the end, and finish with the wardrobe area visibly larger while every source pixel, label, symbol, line, and room relationship remains unchanged.

Over 4 seconds, perform one continuous deterministic 2D zoom toward the central “3,9” wardrobe and existing arrow endpoint. Use an even motion with a short final ease, ending on a closer composition that keeps the entire wardrobe boundary and its connections visible without modifying any source pixels or graphic content.
